articleTitle: Concept, Key Technologies and Challenges of Digital Twin Riverbasin
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: According to the new needs of riverbasin management, the deep integration of new generation information and communication technology riverbasin monitoring and management, and the establishment of a digital twin riverbasin to achieve accurate simulation of riverbasin simulation and intelligent management decision-making have become hot spots in the industry. Starting from the basic concept, motivations and innovative management of the digital twin, this paper puts forward to the basic definition and characteristics of the digital twin riverbasin, the technical framework of digital twin riverbasin, and the key technologies and the facing challenges of the digital twin riverbasin, and proposes a digital twin riverbasin triangle design model based on the characteristics of the riverbasin scenario.

articleTitle: Keyword Spotting with Deep Neural Network on Edge Devices
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Interconnected devices are becoming attractive so-lutions to integrate physical parameters and make them more accessible for further analysis. The exploding number of sensors are demanding huge bandwidth and computational capabilities in the cloud. Additionally, continuous transmission of information to the remote server would hamper privacy. Deep Neural Network (DNN) is proving to be very effective for cognitive tasks and can easily be implemented on edge devices. In this paper, a DNN model was trained and implemented for Keyword Spotting (KWS) on two types of edge devices: a bare-metal embedded device (microcontroller) and a single board computer (Jetson Nano™) based robotic car. The unnecessary components and noise from audio samples were removed and speech features were extracted using Mel-Frequency Cepstral Coefficient (MFCC). A Depthwise Separable Convolutional Neural Network (DS-CNN) based model was proposed and trained with about 721 thousand trainable parameters. After implementing the DNN on a bare-metal platform, the converted model took only 11.52 Kbyte of RAM and 169.63 Kbyte of flash memory. The model was also utilized to develop a voice-controlled robotic vehicle, Jetbot. Thus, this research demonstrates an efficient implementation of DNN on edge devices in two major platforms.

articleTitle: The Effect of Chatbot-customer Interaction on Consumer Brand Advocacy: Exploring the Role of Chatbots
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Chatbot-customer interaction is becoming increasingly prevalent. However, prior literature has not focused on the influence of chatbot-customer interaction on brand advocacy. In this paper, we study the influence mechanism of chatbot-customer interaction on consumer brand advocacy. Through a questionnaire survey of 312 e-commerce users who used artificial intelligence-powered chatbot platforms, our study shows that the functional anthropomorphic interactions significantly affect brand advocacy. Furthermore, customer brand experiences is an intermediary role between chatbot-customer interaction and brand advocacy.

articleTitle: Optimal Pattern Synthesis of Array Antennas Using Improved Grey Wolf Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Grey wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm is a new nature-inspired meta-heuristic algorithm inspired by the social hierarchy and hunting behavior of grey wolves. For GWO algorithm is easily trapped in local optimum and the convergence rate is not ideal. In this paper, we use the improved grey wolf optimization (IGWO) algorithm to Optimal Pattern Synthesis of linear Array Antenna. IGWO algorithm improves convergence factor, adjusting its global search capability and convergence rate. According to the experimental results, IGWO algorithm has been successfully used to reduce the side lobe level (SLL) and form deep null levels in designed directions which meets the design requirements well.

articleTitle: Dangerous Action Recognition for Spatial-Temporal Graph Convolutional Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Human behavior recognition is important to research in intelligent surveillance systems. For the criminal act of dangerous accident prevention and identification, dangerous human behavior of recognition is more than important. Aiming at the identification of dangerous human behavior, a human risk behavior detection algorithm based on a time-space graph convolutional network is proposed. The algorithm first extracts the skeleton sequence of human behavior by monitoring the video in the system. Then based on the obtained skeleton features, combined with the time vector in the skeleton sequence, a spatial time map model is established to identify dangerous behaviors. Finally, the hazard level of the behavior is determined according to the setting of the corresponding threshold. Experimental results on the Kinetics and RGB+D datasets show that the algorithm can identify a variety of dangerous behaviors and can effectively identify dangerous behaviors in different scenarios.

articleTitle: Charging Scheduling Scheme for Maximizing Charging Efficiency to Extend Network Lifetime in WRSNs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Wireless Rechargeable Sensor Network (WRSN) is an emerging technology that has risen intending to enhance the network lifetime of conventional Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs). In this paper, we have come up with a detailed overview of the charging cycles and scheduling schemes in WRSNs where sensor nodes take advantage of wireless power transfer techniques and serve the network for a longer period. Generally, the researchers do accept that using the full charging approach is not ideal due to the limited power of Mobile Charging Vehicles (MCVs) but they neglect the fact that solely using a partial charging scheme is also not the best solution as it increases travel time. After a critical overview of each aspect, we proposed a charging scheduling algorithm using both full and partial charging schemes. First, our scheduling scheme is a distributed architecture where each MCV serves its assigned region. Unlike other schemes, we used a spare MCV instead of deploying depots that can increase the cost of the network. Similarly, we also introduced volunteer charging sessions to lower the back and forth travelling of MCV s. The simulation results showed that our proposed charging scheduling scheme offers promising performance and outperforms in terms of charging efficiency, response time, queue length, and other performance evaluation metrics.

articleTitle: Energy Management Optimization for Connected Hybrid Electric Vehicle with Offline Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Recently, offline deep reinforcement learning (DRL) which is a branch of DRL has been widely concerned and sets off an upsurge of researches related to it. In this paper, we apply a new algorithm called batch-constrained deep Q-learning (BCQ) to search the optimal control strategy for hybrid electric vehicles (HEVs). Then, thanks to the superiority of offline DRL, we put forward a scheduled training framework of energy management strategy (EMS) based on connected vehicles. The results show the BCQ based strategy performs well in both the stabilization of battery SoC and the fuel economy, which reaches 95.05% of DP. Offline DRL possesses a significant applied perspective and provides a new approach for power allocation of HEVs.

articleTitle: Maintenance Study Based on Bayesian Network and Expectation-Maximum Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the applications of large scale wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the number of sensor nodes grows from a few nodes of twenty years ago, a thousand nodes of ten years ago, to today's tens of thousands nodes. As the number of nodes increases, it is a difficult task to maintain their normal working. It is crucial to improve the maintainability of a large-scale WSN due its high cost of maintenance. In this paper, a maintenance technique based on Bayesian network and expectation-maximum (EM) algorithm is proposed. The proposed technique has learning and reasoning capability. It has merits of high efficiency and low cost, which is our research focus for the maintenance of large scale wireless sensor networks. In the proposed technique, Bayesian network and data-driven are used to reduce human subjectivity. The expectation-maximum algorithm is adopted to fully extract the information contained in historical data and reduce the cost of the collection of high-quality data.

articleTitle: The Effect of Training Dataset Size on SAR Automatic Target Recognition Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Synthetic aperture radar (SAR) is an effective remote sensor for target detection and recognition. Deep learning has a great potential for implementing automatic target recognition based on SAR images. In general, Sufficient labeled data are required to train a deep neural network to avoid overfitting. However, the availability of measured SAR images is usually limited due to high cost and security in practice. In this paper, we will investigate the relationship between the recognition performance and training dataset size. The experiments are performed on three classifiers using MSTAR (Moving and Stationary Target Acquisition and Recognition) dataset. The results show us the minimum size of the training set for a particular classification accuracy.

articleTitle: Irrigation Scheduling Optimization for Ecological Security Water and Eco-Environment Relationship
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Water is a key factor for the ecological health and social development of irrigated oases in Northwest China. The change of irrigation water will break the water cycle pattern, may affect food production and ecological stability, and even lead to ecological problems such as wetland shrinkage and vegetation degradation. Hetao irrigation area is the largest first irrigation area in Asia, with an effective irrigation area of 8.61 million mu, but the average annual rainfall is only 168mm. How to coordinate the ternary goal of irrigation water, food security and ecological health is not only a practical problem, but also a common challenge for arid irrigated oases in Northwest China. For the irrigated oasis of outflow River in arid area, the big difference between outflow River and inland river is that the water source of outflow river is relatively sufficient and plays a leading role, with local water resources as auxiliary. The ecological water use problems caused by the development and utilization of water resources in such areas are more significantly affected by man-made, and the transformation process between surface water and groundwater is also very complex. The overall mode is: the external water is transported to each area of the oasis through the multi-level artificial canal system, and the groundwater along the way is replenished to meet the water demand for crop irrigation. At the same time, it also supports the ecological water use of forests, grasslands, lakes and wetlands outside the farmland. The groundwater responds very significantly to the amount of water diversion. Excessive water diversion or excessive water saving will directly lead to the rise and fall of groundwater level in the oasis, and even affect the oasis vegetation ecology and river lake balance. In order to protect the benign development of water cycle ecological effect in the oasis area, the core issue of water resources ecological security is to maintain a certain groundwater level, which is reflected in the balance of groundwater supply and discharge in an appropriate range. The purpose of this study is to analyze the water-yield-ecology response relationship by means of multiple remote sensing data-set, and optimize irrigation scheduling considering the food production, water consumption control and ecological security. To this end, we choose Hetao Irrigation District located in Inner Mongolia as study region. First, we establish remote sensing based model to estimate plantation structure, crop water consumption, food production, and surface soil salinity by multi-sensor satellite data. By long term estimation of water cycle element and groundwater level over 15 years, the study analyze the response relationship of crop water consumption and food production to groundwater level and salinity based on different inflow conditions. Based on the ecological sensitivity of typical crop types of water and food production, a dynamic optimization method of irrigation scheduling targeting shallow groundwater area is proposed, and the water-saving and production-increasing effect is tested.

articleTitle: A Maintainability Evaluation Method of Large Scale Wireless Sensor Networks Based on Sample Entropy
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The evaluation of maintainability for large scale wireless sensor networks (WSNs) is crucial. However little work has been done in such area. In this paper, a maintainability evaluation method is proposed, which is based on sample entropy First of all, we define several parameters, such as affect factor, quality allocation matrix, quality-cost vector, and contribution weight. Each affect factor has a quality-allocation vector. The quality allocation vectors at the same layer of the affect factors can form a quality allocation matrix. The contribution weight, quality allocation matrix, and quality-cost vector work together to construct the system cost function. The quality-cost vector and contribution weight can be subjective or objective. The subjectiveness means that it is given from the expert experience. On the other hand, the objectiveness means that it is derived from the data collected from the on-site field. In the proposed method, the subjectiveness and objectiveness are combined to achieve better system performance. The proposed evaluation method is verified by the data collected in an application field at SIAT dorm. It shows that our proposed method has good performance.

articleTitle: Reversible Multi-Level Watermarking Scheme for Color Images
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Reversible data hiding is to embed data into digital multimedia, while the original multimedia and embedded data can be restored from the watermarked one without any loss. In this paper, we propose a novel Reversible Multi-Level Watermarking (RMLW) scheme for color images with grayscale invariance. Being different from the traditional reversible data hiding methods, we adapt the gray scale-invariant reversible watermarking method which keeps the grayscale of image unchanged as the information is embedded. In the RMLW, one feature region of high robustness is extracted and into which the watermarks are then embedded for multiple times. Lots of experiments have been conducted and the results show that the proposed scheme can extend the capacity efficiently while keep the characteristic of grayscale invariance.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technologies of Passive Positioning System for Personnel under Intelligent Modeling
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The frequent disappearance of outdoor explorers has made the research on outdoor positioning search and rescue systems more and more interesting. LoRa geolocation for outdoor tracking purposes has greatly improved the LoRa spatial positioning accuracy for high-precision differential algorithms under the machine learning model. In the process of improving the 5 sets of data to 8 sets., the positioning performance is the best when there are 5 sets of data. Considering the roadmap and under the condition of visual distance, if you want to continue to improve the accuracy, it is obvious to increase the number of groups, but the computing power of the Drone base station processor is relatively high, so a moderate group is the best.

articleTitle: Trajectory Control of Quadrotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicles with Sliding Mode Adaptive Method
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper proposes a sliding mode adaptive control strategy for the trajectory control of quadrotor unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) when uncertain disturbances may exist in the system during flight. The proposed controller controls the position and attitude of a quadrotor UAV with control laws designed based on the sliding mode control theory. The external disturbances in the UAV system are accurately estimated and compensated based on an adaptive law. Stability analysis based on the Lyapunov stability theory shows that the designed adaptive controller can ensure the convergence to a desired trajectory under the presence of uncertain disturbances. Simulation results show that the robustness and control performance of the proposed adaptive controller is better than that of a PID controller and a controller based on sliding mode control only.

articleTitle: RL-SF: Reinforcement Learning based Scheduling Function for Distributed TSCH Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: IEEE 802.15.4e defines the Time Slotted Channel Hopping (TSCH) mode as an industrial IoT communication technology. In the event of burst traffic patterns, more cells are required to minimize packet loss, yet excessive cell allocations might result in excessive energy usage. In this study, we present a distributed scheduling technique for TSCH networks that uses reinforcement learning algorithms to calculate the required number of cells. The result demonstrates that the proposed algorithm is capable of achieving a high packet delivery ratio while preserving a reasonable network lifetime and end-to-end packet latency.

articleTitle: A Real-time Network Monitoring Technique for Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the wide applications of wireless sensor networks (WSNs), the network working condition monitoring gets more and more important and becomes a research hotspot. For network analysis, it is crucial to obtain the real-time network parameters while the network is working. This paper introduces a network monitoring technique based on sniffing. A sniffer is used to capture the data packets sent by the surrounding nodes. The received data packets can be used to analyze the working condition of the WSN. The proposed real-time network monitoring technique is tested in a student dorm building equipped with electric power supply meters. The experimental results show that the proposed technique is reliable to achieve our goals. The proposed technique is a good tool to study the delay, RSSI, and packet loss of a WSN.

articleTitle: Research on Credit Scoring Based on Transformer-CatBoost Network Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Credit scoring models are widely used in banks and other financial institutions to make credit granting decisions. Over the past few years, many supervised machine learning algorithms have been successfully applied to credit scoring models. These models utilize consumers' historical data to assess the risk associated with an application. However, there are few consideration of integrating supervised learning with unsupervised learning. A hybrid model was proposed in this paper, combining the Transformer networks with the CatBoost decision tree. Firstly, the Transformer network encode and mine the internal information of the original data. Then the CatBoost model train the encoded vector to get the leaves nodes for generating cross features. The novelty of our approach relies on reducing the redundant and noisy features and avoiding the annotation for massive data. Experiments are carried on a real world dataset from a Chinese commercial bank, using to-fold cross validation. The results show that the AUC index and KS index of our model outperform the traditional machine learning methods and the single Transformer network, which confirm the superiority of the integration of unsupervised and supervised machine learning methods.

Index Terms: Area Under Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve

articleTitle: Pattern Synthesis of Array Antennas Using an Improved Flower Pollination Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: An improved flower pollination algorithm (FPA) is introduced to optimize array pattern in pattern synthesis of array antennas. FPA is inspired by flower pollination in nature, most flowering plants carry out long distance cross-pollination through pollinators, such as bees and birds, its behavior obey Levy distribution, so the step length of the FPA also obey Levy distribution. In order to improve the optimization performance of FPA, a flower pollination algorithm combining dynamic convergence factor and golden sine (DGSFPA) is used for pattern synthesis of array antennas in this manuscript. In DGSFPA, dynamic convergence factor is introduced in cross-pollination to improve the algorithm convergence accuracy; gold sine optimization is used in self-pollination to enhance the ability to jump out of the local optimum. In this paper, DGSFPA is used in linear antenna arrays for pattern synthesis and applied for the minimization of the first side lobe lever (SLL) nearest to the main beam and the peak SLL in side lobe region. Two experiments are carried out to verify the effectiveness of DGSFPA in linear array optimization. Experimental results show that DGSFPA provides lower level in peak SLL and the first side lobe level nearest to the main beam, compared with original FPA and grey wolf optimization (GWO) algorithm.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Oriented Visual Saliency Analysis on 360-Degree Panoramic Image
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Digital product definition (DPD) has experienced the development from two-dimensional (2D) to three-dimensional (3D). Recently, the experience of domestic and foreign manufacturing industries has shown that the product model defined by 3D digitalization has matured, and its benefits have been repeatedly verified. Panoramic Image is a fundamental technique to reflect the real-world scenario in the form of a 360-degree image, providing an immersive experience to users. However, observers may be only interested in part of 360-degree images and neglect other parts. Visual saliency analysis becomes essential to understanding user behavior. Saliency in the image represents the region that attracts human attention to certain areas of the image. The approach to extracting the areas and information that users are concerned about from pictures has gradually become a challenge in computer vision. Visual saliency analysis can effectively utilize computer resources to allocate bits to the more critical pixels in the image. Different from regular plane pictures, panoramic pictures contain more visual information about the real-world scenario. Images from other angles are actually projected onto a plane, which may cause severe distortion of plane panoramic images via projection conversion. It will cause serious distortion if the segmentation obtained by the saliency prediction model is directly spliced. Herein, we propose a novel panoramic image Mosaic method based on the Truncated Square Pyramid Projection scheme (TSP). Simulation results show the effectiveness of the proposed scheme.

articleTitle: Study on the k-Connectivity of UV Communication Network with Pulse Position Modulation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Owing to the high confidentiality, low potentiometer resolution, strong anti-interference ability and good environmental adaptability, ultraviolet (UV) communication is widely used in the field of optical communication. To better exploit the advantages and attenuate the impact of disadvantages such as serious atmospheric loss and short transmission distance, a study of wireless UV self-organizing network with pulse position modulation is carried out in this study. Based on the Monte Carlo method, simulation analysis is carried out, and the path loss parameters under different transceiver elevation angles are obtained. Besides, the communication radii of UV nodes with pulse position modulation are derived, and the correlation between k-connectivity and some communication parameters of UV networks is explored. The results illustrate that a negative correlation is maintained between network connectivity rate and data rate; and node density and transmit power are positively correlated. The research in this study can provide reference for future applications of UV communication networks.

articleTitle: A Web Service composition Method Based on Improved Whale Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: To solve the optimization problem of service composition, a WOA based algorithm is proposed that called iWOA in this paper. The iWOA uses AHP and SAW to confirm parameters for fitness function, and uses tent map and OBL to initialize population. Then a diversity mutation operation is performed to reduce the probability of premature convergence in the iterations. The experiment results shows that the iWOA is effective.

articleTitle: A Multi-Agents Survivable Deep Reinforced Routing and Spectrum Assignment Algorithm in Elastic Optical Network
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: We propose an intelligent survivable RSA algorithm with multi agents based on deep reinforcement learning in EON to face multiple services and improve the survivability of network. Simulation result shows that the proposed algorithm can reduce packet loss rate and Improve resource utilization well.

articleTitle: Analysis of Representative Invention Patents on Train Signal Control Technique of Thales SEC Transport
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Urban rail transit signal system is a kind of complex large-scale system, which is used for train dispatching command, traffic control and other aspects. It is the core to ensure high safety and high efficiency of urban rail transit organization and operation control. Its research and development (R&D) enterprises usually have high industry qualifications. As the first enterprise undertaking the communication based train control (CBTC) system applied to urban rail transit in China, it is of no doubt that Thales Shanghai Electric Group Company (SEC) Transport has strong R&D ability in signal system, and it has applied for a large number of invention patents in this field in the past 20 years. Invention patent is the very scientific and technological literature that can best reflect the strategic layout of enterprise and even industry technology development. However, up to now, there is little discussion on the technical development of rail transit signal system from the perspective of invention patents applied by an enterprise. In this paper, the invention patents applied by Thales SEC Transportation in the field of train signal control technique has been taken as the research object, combined with the company situation, its core patents has been interpreted, and the technological development context of the railway signal control industry reflected by the enterprise has also been analyzed and sorted out.

articleTitle: Ridge Regression Based on Koropov Sequence Initialized Archimedes Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Ridge regression is a biased estimation regression method specially used for collinear data analysis. It is in essence an improved least square estimation method by abandoning the unbiased nature of least square method, the regression coefficient can be obtained at the cost of losing some information and reducing accuracy. It is more practical and reliable, for it can fit of ill conditioned data better than the least square method. The main idea of ridge regression is to use L2 regularization to lose some information and reduce the accuracy, so as to obtain the best parameters. In order to better optimize the loss function to find the best parameters, gradient descent (GD) or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method are usually used to find the most appropriate solution. However, the gradient dependent methods have two significant disadvantages: (1) it is easy to fall into local minimum; (2) with the progress of iteration, the closer it is to the optimal solution, the more prone it is to sawtooth effect. In order to improve the performance of global convergence in the process of optimization, in this paper, a Koropov sequence initialized Archimedes optimization algorithm (KSAOA) has been proposed to replace the GD and SGD in solving the loss function of ridge regression, and its advantage in overcoming the disadvantage of gradient dependent methods and its effectiveness is verified by numerical experiments.

articleTitle: Collaborative Filtering Algorithm Based on Sliding Window
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Due to the emergence of more and more untrustworthy cloud service providers. How to avoid these untrustworthy cloud services when choosing cloud services has become an urgent concern of researchers. QoS as a criterion for evaluating a quality of service is often used as a basis for selection. Collaborative Filtering is a common algorithm to predict QoS in existing research. However, the traditional collaborative filtering covers some untrusted data in the prediction, which will bring deviation to the prediction results. In this paper, sliding window is introduced on the basis of the collaborative filtering to deal with untrusted data to improve the accuracy of prediction

articleTitle: Recognition of Score Word in Freestyle Kayaking
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Speech is the most natural information carrier for human beings, and it is likely to become the main way of human-computer interaction in the future. This paper presents an isolated score word recognition method using Mel-scale Frequency Cepstral Coefficients (MFCC) and Dynamic Time Warping (DTW). The processing stage of the speech signal is the basic stage of the speech recognition system, to analyze the speech signal and convert it into speech feature parameters. An endpoints detection method is proposed using the joint adjustment of short-term energy and zero-crossing rate. It can better detect the endpoints, and directly improve the accuracy of subsequent work. On this basis, the MFCC feature is then extracted from the preprocessed speech signal, and the DTW pattern matching is applied to the extracted features. In the experiments, speeches from multiple speakers were collected, each with a specific freestyle kayak action word. The results show that this method has better performance comparing with the existing methods.

articleTitle: A Large-Scale Analysis of COVID-19 Twitter Dataset in a New Phase of the Pandemic
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Social media have been awash with news and discussions of the COVID-19 pandemic. It is phenomenal to observe that social media has been the focal venue for people to express their reactions, opinions, and interpretations of the pandemic, given the presence of mixed sources of real information and misinformation. Thus, it is essential to conduct professional assessments of the public views and their evolving nature. Our study aims to extract and assess insights into the reflections of sentiments and topics of the public on Twitter and their dynamics along the timeline of the Delta variant. It highlights the extraordinary influence Twitter, or similar major social media, would have on people to comprehend and decide how to cope with the pandemic. We present findings of extracted sentiments and topics from a large-scale dataset of COVID-related tweets collected for the recent phase of the Delta variant of the pandemic (July-September 2021). We utilized a variety of machine learning algorithms for topic modeling and testing the accuracy of sentiment analysis. Our study shows the dramatic dominance of a positive and objective sentiment rather than a negative and subjective sentiment as well as the shift of prevalent topics during the period of study. The findings indicate the importance of conveying real, rational, and accurate information instead of misinformation on social media to foster the public's awareness and preparedness for a major public emergency incident such as the pandemic.

articleTitle: Research on Classification Method of Sensitive Structural Data of Electric Power
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the necessity of classification of sensitive data from the importance of electric power structured data, and puts forward the classification identification method of structural sensitive data of electric power enterprises from data survey, data classification to construction of sensitive field database.

articleTitle: Research on Key Technology of Terminal Equipment Security Protection for Energy Internet
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The power Internet of Things platform is an important support for digital innovation services of the energy Internet, covering all aspects of the power system, with many new security problems. How to realize the extensive trusted interconnection and reliable perception of the Power Internet of Things, how to realize the intelligent defense and security interaction of the power system, and how to solve the data, application and key security of the power information system are the important problems to be solved by the power Internet of things at present. Based on the development status of energy Internet, the security requirements and characteristics of power Internet of Things are explained and analyzed. On this basis, the security framework and protection ideas of power Internet of Things are put forward, and the key technologies of power Internet of things are summarized and the corresponding development direction in the future is explained.

articleTitle: The Development and Application of “Interactive Visualized Emergency Smart Plan” System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of insufficient informationization and low intelligence level of emergency plan, the “Interactive Visualized Emergency Smart Plan” system is proposed by using the intelligent interactive deduction, scenario construction and other technologies. The system consists of seven main functions in accordance with the basic procedure for emergency response. The first function is event management. It realizes the management and count of current and historical events. The second function is monitoring and early warning. Connecting with relevant early-warning and monitoring systems, the latest monitoring and early-warning data are obtained. The data are used for proposing accurate early-warning information. The third function is response action. The emergency plan is digitally disassembled for emergencies, and the corresponding response tasks are pushed to remind users according to user personnel account. The fourth function is resource statistics. The emergency information and data, which are useful for users in emergency response research and judgment, are collected in the system. The fifth function is to-do reminder. The system displays the latest to-do items of the current user account and makes regular reminders. The sixth function is emergency plan management. Relevant emergency plans can be viewed, and real-time update management can be performed after the revision of the plan. The seventh function is knowledge retrieval. The quick query and full-text search of emergency information assist users to get emergency related knowledge quickly. The functions in this system can be customized according to the actual needs of each user. Using the “Interactive Visualized Emergency Smart Plan” system, the practicality, pertinence, scientificity, and operability of emergency plans are improved, and the intelligence of plan management is realized.

articleTitle: A Heterogeneous Network Handover Algorithm for Hybrid Networking Mode in MCPTT System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the problem that the traditional heterogeneous network handover algorithms cannot meet the network handover requirements in the hybrid networking mode in MCPTT system, a heterogeneous network handover algorithm for hybrid networking mode is proposed in MCPTT system. Firstly, the handover decision process is decided whether to execute according to the current network mode and network conditions. Secondly, the subjective and objective weights of network attributes are calculated by AHP and Entropy Weight Method respectively, which are combined into comprehensive weight. Then, the comprehensive weight is used to weight the attribute parameters of the candidate networks, and TOPSIS is used to sort the candidate networks. Finally, the best target network is selected from the top two candidate networks according to the network load. The simulation results show that the proposed heterogeneous network handover algorithm has good accuracy, and reduce the number of network handovers and the handover blocking rate effectively.

articleTitle: A Python Toolbox for Surrogate-based Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In engineering optimization, machine learning becomes increasingly popular to intelligently obtain a continuous approximation in terms of discrete samples, so that the number of expensive experiments can be significantly reduced. Based on it, some typical steps of optimization process, e.g., search for the optimum, sensitivity analysis (SA), visualization, and statistical analysis, can be achieved. This method is also named as surrogate-based optimization (SBO). That is because only an approximation, rather than real functional relationship, between the objective and variables, is obtained in optimization. Currently, many toolboxes are proposed to achieve one or several functionalities in typical SBO. However, those toolboxes usually contain basic functionalities rather than comprehensive and the most advanced techniques, which makes them difficult to robustly solve complicated optimization problems. In the paper, a toolbox, namely, vehicular aerodynamic engineering optimization in Python (VAEOpy), is addressed. The VAEOpy comprehensively includes functionalities for design of experiments (DOE), Kriging metamodeling, neural network (NN), evolutionary computation, efficient global optimization (EGO), SA, and visualization. Therefore, flexible applications of different techniques can be achieved by users. Moreover, the object-oriented programming (OOP) and matrix operation (vectorization) in the VAEOpy also make it highly extendable and efficient. The VAEOpy is also compared with other two toolboxes for Kriging metamodeling and solving single-objective problem (SOP). The results show that the VAEOpy not only has higher performance to tune the hyperparameters of a Kriging model with high efficiency, but also provides more robust strategies of point infill to push optimization toward convergence.

articleTitle: An Improved Method for Long-term Drift Compensation of Electronic Nose with Batch Control
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Sensor long-time drift compensation has always been a huge and important research challenge. To address this problem, this paper proposes a simple and efficient long-time drift compensation method based on a short-time memory-forgetting mechanism. The proposed improved method controls the update frequency of memory and forgetting by introducing a batch control coefficient to achieve a balance between the update frequency of memory queue and model iteration. In this paper, we use the gas sensor array drift dataset as the research object and design two experimental strategies to verify the processing time compression degree and the accuracy change of the classification model by adjusting the batch control coefficient. The experiments prove that the proposed method in this paper has an excellent effect on compressing data processing time and relieving hardware pressure, which has a certain reference value for related research.

articleTitle: Physical Layer Encryption Scheme Based on Population Evolution Iteration and Nonlinear Companding in CO-OFDM System
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: A physical layer encryption scheme based on population evolution iteration (PEI) and nonlinear companding is proposed to improve the security and reduce peak-to-average power ratio of the coherent optical orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (CO-OFDM) system. Simulation conducted in a 28Gbaud 16QAM system proves that the scheme can reduce the PAPR by 4dB, while the bit error rate of eavesdropper is about 0.5, which indicates that the scheme can guarantee the security on the premise of ensuring efficient transmission.

articleTitle: A Blockchain-based Mobile Core Network Architecture with Aggregated Control Plane
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The core network plays an important role of control-ling hub in the mobile communication system, which is responsi-ble for user equipment's registration, authentication and session establishment. In order to meet the demand of 5G, the Service-based Architecture core network is proposed by 3GPP, featuring network functions with Service-based Interface. Driven by the increasingly diversified application scenarios, the future mobile communication system needs to support the connection and integration of wide-area distributed heterogeneous devices and become more open. Meanwhile, it also needs to further enhance its efficiency, scalability and reliability. Based on the nature of decentralization, immutability, transparency and customizability, blockchain can offer helpful solutions to aforementioned chal-lenges. In this paper, we proposed a blockchain-based mobile core network architecture with aggregated control plane to address related issues. The experimental evaluation results show that our design can perform well in the case of emergency communication.

articleTitle: Automatic Modulation Recognition Based on Spatio-temporal Features Fusion
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Automatic Modulation Recognition (AMR) has substantial implications in civilian and military communications. Lately, the neural network model has been increasingly used for AMR. However, the previous models have ignored the spatio-temporal characteristics of the signals, which leads to insufficient classification accuracy under low signal-to-noise ratio, especially for certain specific modulation types, like MQAM. Combining the advantages of the complex-valued convolutional neural networks and the long short-term memory networks (LSTM), this paper proposes a novel AMR method based on spatio-temporal features fusion with complex convolution modules and LSTMs, denoted as bi-channel complex-convolutional neural networks with LSTM (BCLNN). BCLNN efficiently explores the spatial-temporal properties of raw complex signals and achieves higher classification accuracy for AMR, especially under a low signal-to-noise ratio and for MQAM modulation. Experimental results dedicate that when the SNR is between −20dB and −10dB, the average accuracy of BCLNN is at least 7.9% higher than that of other networks. BCLNN has a more than 12% improvement of average recognition rate for 16QAM and 64QAM when the SNR is between −20dB and 18dB.

articleTitle: Research on OSPF Oriented Space Network Monitoring and Management Technology under IPv6
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In the context of the vigorous development of space networks, more and more space networks are built using IPv6 protocol and OSPF routing protocol. In this paper, a scheme of space network monitoring and management is proposed, designed and implemented. It can obtain status information such as space network topology and routing, and realize space network management operations.

articleTitle: Locally Linear Embedding Based on Neiderreit Sequence Initialized Pelican Optimization Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Locally linear embedding (LLE) algorithm is an important nonlinear dimensionality reduction method in the field of manifold learning of artificial intelligence (AI). The core idea of LLE is to find a homeomorphic mapping that can ensure that the linear algebraic structure of low-dimensional spatial data projected from high-dimensional spatial data remains unchanged. LLE contains two optimization sub-problems, and gradient descent (GD) or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method is often used for parameter optimization. However, gradient dependent method is easy to fall into the trap of local minimum, resulting in failure to find the global optimal solution. In order to overcome the above problems, in this paper, a new Neiderreit sequence initialized pelican optimization algorithm (NSPOA) has been proposed, to help LLE find the global optimal parameter properly. Numerical experiment has shown that NSPOA has higher operation efficiency than traditional gradient dependent optimization methods.

articleTitle: An Improved DV-Hop Node Localization Algorithm Based on Sparrow Search for WSNs
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Localization technology is one of the key technology of wireless sensor networks. Its most concerned elements are higher accuracy and lower cost. In this paper, a novel intelligent computing technology, sparrow search algorithm, is used to improve the traditional DV-Hop algorithm, and an improved DV-Hop node localization algorithm based on sparrow search (SSDV-Hop) was proposed. The experimental results show that, compared with the SSA and DV-Hop algorithms, the SSDV-Hop algorithm proposed in this paper has higher localization accuracy, better anti-ranging error performance, and is more conducive to reducing or controlling network costs.

articleTitle: Design of Digital Measurement System for Sensor Signal Distortion Based on Undersampling Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Based on the single chip microcomputer (MSP432P401R) as the core, automatic gain control (AGC) circuit, signal conditioning circuit, LCD display module, frequency measurement circuit, wireless transmission module and other circuits as peripheral modules constitute the overall system scheme. In the processing part of analog to digital converter (ADC) signal acquisition, the principle of undersampling in signal acquisition is adopted. Through theoretical analysis, the effective high-order harmonic components are extracted in the case of spectrum aliasing, so that the complete high-frequency signal waveform can be obtained at lower sampling frequency, and then the fundamental and high-order harmonic components in the signal are analyzed to obtain the total harmonic distortion (THD). Based on reliable hardware design and software algorithm, the function of distortion measurement is realized, which has the advantages of high precision, fast response and high integration.

articleTitle: Principal Component Analysis Based on t-Distribution Hunting Search Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Principal component analysis (PCA) is a linear dimensionality reduction algorithm in machine learning (ML), it plays an important role in feature extraction and noise removal. Its idea is to solve the maximum variance parameters of low dimensional spatial projection data by gradient descent (GD) method or stochastic gradient descent (SGD) method, so as to determine the optimal submanifold in low dimensional space. However, GD method or SGD method are easy to fall into the trap of local minimum, and are difficult to obtain the global optimal solution. In this paper, a t-distribution hunting search algorithm (THSA) with global optimization ability is proposed to replace the GD optimization method and improve the dimensionality reduction effect of PCA.

articleTitle: Adaptive Coordinated Control for Spacecraft Formation with Event-triggered Communication
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The problem of distributed coordinated control for spacecraft formation with limited communication, uncertainties and disturbances is investigated. First, to reduce the communication burden caused by continuous communication, the triggered function is designed to monitor the updated time. Then, under the directed topology and the condition that only a subset of follower spacecraft can access to the leader, an adaptive coordinated control algorithm is proposed to compensate uncertainties and disturbances. In addition, it is proved that no follower spacecraft exhibits Zeno behavior. Finally, the effectiveness of the proposed coordinated control laws is illustrated by simulation results.

articleTitle: A Real-time Monitoring Method for the Simulation Test System of IoT Management Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to promote the standardized access of all kinds of IoT terminals to the IoT management platform, this paper proposes a real-time monitoring method for the simulation test system of the IoT management platform. The content of real-time monitoring of the test process of the simulation test system of the IoT management platform is based on the key information of the equipment access process of the IoT management platform to conduct screening and packaging desensitization, which is realized according to several key steps and key interaction information of the equipment access process. It mainly includes: device access request, device sending to data platform, sending commands to device, online request screening, packaging and desensitization processing, real-time display of the detailed process of device access joint commissioning test. It supports one-click clearing of real-time monitoring interface to reduce content occupation, realize standardized access of various IoT terminals of intelligent IoT system, and improve the plug and play capability of terminal devices.

articleTitle: A Fast Blind Noise Estimation Algorithm for High ISO Images Based on Local Variance
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: For the problem that traditional noise estimation algorithms do not take the noise characteristic under actual conditions into consideration, a fast blind noise estimation algorithm for high ISO images based on local variance is proposed. Firstly, random sampling positions are generated, and ineffective sampling positions are removed by using the improved edge detection algorithm based on canny operator. Then, the gray level and the average local variance of smooth image regions is calculated according to the gray level and the local variance of image blocks. Finally, the fitting function of the average local variance and the gray level is constructed to obtain the estimate of noise level. The simulation results show that the proposed algorithm is faster and more accurate than the traditional algorithms.

articleTitle: Simplified Radius-directed Linear Kalman Filter for Blind Polarization Demultiplexing
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: To solve the problem of communication interruption caused by the ultra-fast rotation of the state of polarization (RSOP) in the OPGW cable which caused by lightning strikes. a simplified radius-directed linear Kalman filter for blind polarization demultiplexing was proposed. The effective of different lightning current induced RSOP for blind polarization demultiplexing method was studied. The results showed that the proposed method can effectively deal with the rotation of the state of polarization caused by lightning strikes.

Author Keywords: rotation of the state of polarization

articleTitle: Development and Application of Data Processing Software for Geo-resistivity
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Observation and analysis of geo-resistivity is one of the important methods of earthquake prediction. Based on the geo-resistivity data observed by a seismic station in 2020, a data processing software is designed and developed. Based on the object-oriented programming thought and double-buffer drawing technology, the daily average, 5-day average and monthly average of geo-resistivity data can be easily displayed and drawn. The software is designed and developed in the Visual C++ integrated development environment, and provides a friendly interactive interface. The software provides practical tools for the analysis and application of geo-resistivity observation data, and plays an important role in daily work of seismic stations.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Intelligent Computing in IoT-Visual Analysis Based on CiteSpace Knowledge Map
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: In order to analyze the application research of intelligent computing technology in the Internet of Things at home and abroad, find the similarities and differences between domestic and foreign research hotspots, status quo and future development trend, this paper makes quantitative statistics and qualitative analysis on the number of articles published by intelligent computing in the Internet of Things from 2010 to 2021, keyword co-occurrence knowledge map, keyword clustering knowledge map and keyword time zone knowledge map, etc. Finally, it is concluded that in recent years, the research on the application of intelligent computing in the field of Internet of Things has been widely concerned by academic circles; The number of papers published on the application of intelligent computing in the field of Internet of Things is increasing rapidly. The research on the application algorithm of intelligent computing in the field of Internet of Things and its integration with emerging technologies have become hot research contents at home and abroad, and the combination of domestic and foreign technologies with specific application fields will become the future research trend.

articleTitle: Big Data System Testing Method Based on Chaos Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The big data systems usually have multiple interdependent network-elements and processes. With the gradual growth in the number of network-elements and the complexity of networking, the possibility of system abnormalities also increases, then the influences of faults on the system are difficult to assess. For effectively discovering the possible defects of big data system products and solving the stability problem of the evaluation system, chaos engineering is employed for the big data systems, and a big data system testing method based on chaos engineering is proposed. The proposed method, which is fault-tolerant, resilient and reliable, mainly includes the processes, i.e., exception injection, exception recovery, system correctness verification, observable real-time data statistics, and result reporting. The experimental results illustrate that the proposed big data system based on chaos method can shorten the development cycle of the version by 20% and observe 21 hidden faults caused by improper handling of abnormal scenarios, which effectively improves the robustness and stability of the distributed system.

articleTitle: Automatic Identification of Textual Topic Structure-Topic Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, extracting text information has been widely used in lots of aspects in our lives. Text segmentation is an extremely important part of text processing. Usually, after obtaining a text which contains a huge amount of information needs to be split into several parts, and then to be analyzed, studied and used. The TextTiling algorithm is one of the text segmentation methods, and this algorithm is a method proposed based on the structure of the article, which can realize the text extraction of several subtopics. Compared to storing the whole text, this method can greatly reduce the storage requirement, and make the efficiency of searching higher. Moreover, it can be applied in many fields, such as keyword search, information finding, automatic summary, etc.

articleTitle: Twin-Field Quantum Key Distribution Protocol with Heralded Single-Photon Source
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Twin-field quantum key distribution (TF-QKD) can overcome the fundamental rate-loss limit in the point-to-point QKD without a quantum repeater and achieve high key rates over long distances. However, TF-QKD protocol and its variants commonly use weak coherent pulses (WCPs) as light sources. The vacuum part of WCP accounts for a large proportion, resulting in the lower photon detection rate of the communication receiver, which leads to a shorter transmission distance of the secret key. In this paper, we propose an active-decoy TF-QKD protocol with heralded single-photon source (HSPS), which can achieve higher key rate and longer transmission distance than the active-decoy TF-QKD protocol with WCPs. Also, in order to resist the side channel attacks caused by actively modulating intensity of the pulses, we propose a passive-decoy TF-QKD protocol with HSPS to enhance the security, which can perform almost as good as the active-decoy TF-QKD protocol with WCPs.

articleTitle: A Novel Scheme of Delay Attack-resistant Network Based on Optical Coding
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: We propose and investigate a novel scheme of delay attack-resistant network based on optical code division multiple access (OCDMA). The bit error rate (BER) is analyzed theoretically, and the closed expression of BER is obtained. The system has a corresponding optimal threshold to minimize the BER in different cases. At the same transmission power, the BER will decrease when the code weight increases. Furthermore, the maximum number of users is different with different code weight and transmission power. Optisystem simulation results show that OCDMA system has delay attack-resistant performance, which can effectively improve the physical layer security of optical network.

articleTitle: Eliminating the Effects of Jump Phenomenon for WiFi Driving Behavior Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Feature extraction-based methods are frequently used for driving behavior recognition systems using the fine-grained CSI from the PHY layer. However, we discover a jump phenomenon: there are switches of frequency-selected fading in random individual time slots, called jump points. Moreover, the jump phenomenon causes the extracted feature values to be inaccurate, resulting in erroneous behavior classification. In this paper, to eliminate the effects of the jump phenomenon, the Pearson correlation coefficient is introduced to detect the position of jump points. Meanwhile, by transforming this problem as an optimization problem, we propose a similarity calculation model and introduce a nested switch-mode firefly algorithm to correct the jump point. The method is tested by the experiments conducted in three indoor scenarios. The results indicate that the proposed method can effectively solve the problem caused by the jump phenomenon and improve the stability of eigenvalues.

articleTitle: Research on Emergency Navigation Path Planning System for Plateau Regions
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The study of emergency navigation path planning methods in plateau regions has very important economic and social significance. In this paper, we proposed a system design scheme combining road network database and satellite remote sensing images with a flat plateau region as the research object. The proposed system performs image pre-processing operations on real-time remote sensing images based on historical remote sensing data, road network extraction and land classification using remote sensing semantic segmentation techniques, and rasterized maps are established in combination with the road network database, taking into account the different types of motion carriers and the influence of image noise for fast emergency navigation path planning. The proposed system architecture approach is a reference value for research in related fields.

articleTitle: Digital Twin Riverbasin and Digital Riverbasin Engineering
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: from the acquisition of riverbasin perception data to the processing of riverbasin full-dimensional data, from the three-dimensional scene model of riverbasin to the riverbasin digital twin model, the next development direction is digital riverbasin engineering. Starting from the construction of digital riverbasin, this paper systematically studies the professional model of digital riverbasin, the twin model of digital twin riverbasin and the overall modeling of riverbasin, and puts forward the basic concept and platform architecture of digital riverbasin engineering. The research results can provide theoretical, methodological guidance and technical support for the construction of digital twin riverbasin and future digital riverbasin engineering.

articleTitle: Joint Learning and Self-training for Poetry Sentiment Recognition
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Poetry is a literary genre full of diverse sentiments, and its sentiment recognition task helps people to better understand the content of poetry, so it is a challenging and interesting NLP task. The existing work has achieved good results in the controllable generation of sentiment, while the recognition accuracy needs to be further enhanced. In this paper, we propose a joint loss method which calculate the line loss and the character loss, adopt self-training to help poetry line level sentiment recognition, and achieved good results in various indicators.

articleTitle: IoT Data Forecasting Based on Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the development of IoT technology in recent years, IoT sensors are widely used in various scenarios and provide continuous data support for the corresponding IoT services. However, the sensors may be interrupted in the process of data collection and transmission due to external interference or their own factors, which may lead to the interruption of the corresponding IoT services, and eventually affect the normal production order and even cause economic losses. IoT data is a kind of time series data. Therefore, this paper constructs a time series data prediction model based on Convolutional Neural Network's feature extraction ability and Gate Recurrent Unit's time series relationship extraction ability combined with attention mechanism. Finally, the model proposed in this paper is used to predict Beijing PM2.5 data under certain conditions. The results show that compared with the traditional time series data prediction model, the prediction error of this model is reduced by 11.7% at most and 20.9% at least, which effectively improves the accuracy of time series data prediction.

articleTitle: The Framework and Practices of Digital Twin City
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: Digital twin city has become an important choice and trend of urban digital transformation. Based on the theory of digital twin this paper proposed “4+5” digital twin city framework and applied it to the study of digital twin cases in China, the United States, France and other countries, analyzed the challenges being faced. Suggestions and guidance on the development of digital twin city were given to city builders and suppliers, as well as governments for strategic planning.

articleTitle: A Lightweight Identity Authentication Protocol in the Internet of Things Environment
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: The number of Internet of things (IoT) terminal devices is large and the resources of terminal devices are limited. The traditional identity authentication protocol is difficult to meet the needs of lightweight and security authentication. This thesis proposes a lightweight identity authentication protocol based on elliptic encryption algorithm. The main body of the protocol is divided into authorization center, authentication node and terminal devices. The authorization center plays the role of trusted center (CA) in the traditional identity authentication protocol, but it is lighter, You do not have to store certificates for each device. Zero knowledge authorization protocol is adopted to reduce the risk of private key exposure caused by key escrow. Replace the digital certificate with a lightweight token, and use the double check method for access authentication in combination with the public key pair generated by the terminal equipment. Finally, this thesis analyzes the security and performance of the protocol, and proves that the protocol has strong security and good performance.

articleTitle: A Behavior-Based Dynamic Reputation Management Model in P2P Applications
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: With the rapid development of the Internet and technological innovation, the number of computers and resources connected to P2P (Peer to Peer) networks is increasing. It has become a trend to share all kinds of hardware and software resources through the network to provide unified and open computing and resource interaction environment. Peer-to-Peer networks have the characteristics of heterogeneous, dynamic, and distributed, which make it challenging to provide trusted and secure application environments and services for users in this scenario. Trust management system is a supplement to traditional security technology and is an important way to realize trusted networks and trusted computing. While the unconstrained behaviors of users and the characteristics of decentralization, scalability, anonymity, and autonomy make it difficult to ensure the trustworthiness of the application environment and vulnerable to malicious attacks. To resolve these problems, researchers have proposed reputation-based trust models, obtaining inspiration from the establishment of trust relationships in human society. However, the aggregate calculation methods of reputation degree are subjective and vulnerable to malicious behaviors based on the historical interactive and feedback evaluation information. In this paper, we are proposing a behavior-based trust management model for P2P networking applications, where we base our method on “Consistent with words and deeds”, the evaluation of behavior credibility using fuzzy sets, and create the trust calculation not restricted to feedback trust which is aggregated by subjective service feedbacks. Our simulation experiments indicate that our proposed model could maintain a good performance under the malicious services of malicious nodes.

articleTitle: The Effect of Mentor-student Interactions on Brand Creation: A Grounded Theory Study
publicationTitle: 2022 IEEE 12th International Conference on Electronics Information and Emergency Communication (ICEIEC)
abstract: This paper explores the influence mechanism of mentor-student interaction(MSI) on mentor brand creation and university brand creation based on grounded theory. We conducted in-depth interviews with 27 interviewees, and then used NVivo software to qualitatively study the interview transcripts. Firstly, the interviews were open coded to identify the initial concepts of MSI and university brand creation, secondly, the initial concepts were summarized into different initial categories based on the open coding, and finally, the relationships between the core categories and other categories were summarized by selective coding, and a theoretical model of “MSI - quality of study experience - perceived value-mentor brand advocacy-university brand advocacy” was constructed. The model shows that functional, social, and ethical interactions between mentors and postgraduate students play an important role in the creation of mentor brands and university brands. These three interactions positively influence students' advocacy of their mentor's personal brand and the university's organizational brand by enhancing the quality and perceived value of the postgraduate student's experience. This study corroborates that mentors are a core element in university brand creation. Mentors and universities can refer to the findings of this study to guide and regulate mentors' interaction behaviors with postgraduate students.
